nodes.description: A heterozygous nonsense or frameshift variant in the exons encoding the C-propeptide of the pro-alpha1(II) chain, near the 3' end of COL2A1. The first reported allele was a 5-bp duplication in exon 51; later alleles include a nonsense change in the last exon. Two non-truncating C-propeptide alleles (a missense change and an in-frame deletion) have also been found in individuals with this phenotype.

nodes.description: Abnormal ossification of the vertebral bodies, pelvis, epiphyses and tubular bones. nodes.description: The truncated pro-alpha1(II) chain lacks cysteine residues and other C-propeptide sequences required for chain association, so it cannot take part in procollagen triple-helix formation and accumulates in the endoplasmic reticulum of chondrocytes. The mechanism is disputed: the ClinGen curation records loss of function as the mechanism (see the discussion attached to this node).
